item.title: commandline: Designing product simplicity for the AI era
item.description:
The article asks whether shared design components are sufficient for a seamless product experience, or whether designers need to prioritize simplicity over complexity to create consistency. It frames this as a product design question for the AI era.

  • Source: Microsoft Command Line Blog
